summary: Community Health Systems, Inc. via its subsidiary CHS/Community Health Systems, Inc. commenced a tender offer to purchase up to $600M aggregate purchase price (exclusive of accrued interest) of its outstanding 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 (up to $350M cap) and 10.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2032 (up to $250M cap). The tender is financed from cash on hand, with terms detailed in an Offer to Purchase dated April 22, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. The structure is a cash tender for secured notes, subject to acceptance priority levels and early tender payments. Watch for proration and total consideration levels; risk-arb angle focuses on take-up ratios and whether the issuer increases caps.
